# National Cyber Crime Reporting

## Source
Government of India - National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal

## Topic
Cyber Crime Reporting and Financial Fraud

## Financial Cyber Fraud

If a person becomes a victim of financial cyber fraud, the incident should be reported as soon as possible.

Quick reporting can help initiate appropriate action.

## Cyber Crime Helpline

For reporting financial cyber fraud in India:

1930

The helpline is intended for reporting cyber financial fraud.

## Online Complaint

Cybercrime complaints can be submitted through the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal:

https://www.cybercrime.gov.in/

## Information to Keep Ready

When reporting a cyber financial fraud, keep relevant information available, such as:

When reporting a cyber financial fraud, keep relevant information available, such as:

- Transaction ID
- Transaction date and time
- Transaction amount
- Bank or payment-service details
- UPI ID or account details involved
- Screenshots
- SMS or email messages
- Phone numbers involved
- Other relevant evidence

## Preserve Evidence

Do not delete relevant messages, screenshots, transaction records, or other information related to the incident.

Such information may be useful when submitting a complaint.

## Use Official Channels

Use the official cybercrime portal and official bank channels when reporting fraud.

Be cautious of people who claim they can recover lost money in exchange for payment or confidential banking information.

## Source URL

https://www.cybercrime.gov.in/

# What To Do After UPI Fraud

## Source
National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)

## Topic
Actions After Suspected UPI Fraud

## Act Quickly

If you believe that a fraudulent UPI transaction has occurred, act as quickly as possible.

## Contact Your Bank

Contact your bank through its official customer-support channel and report the suspicious or unauthorized transaction.

Do not use phone numbers or contact details received from an unknown person or suspicious message.

## Report the Fraud

Keep important transaction information available when reporting the incident.

Useful information may include:

- Transaction ID
- Transaction date and time
- Transaction amount
- UPI ID or recipient details
- Screenshots of relevant messages or transactions

## Protect Your Account

## Protect Your Account

If you suspect that your banking credentials or authentication information has been compromised, follow your bank's official instructions to secure your account.

Never share your UPI PIN, OTP, password, or other confidential banking information while seeking help.

## Preserve Evidence

Keep relevant evidence such as:

- Transaction screenshots
- SMS messages
- Emails
- Phone numbers
- UPI IDs
- Payment references
- Other communication related to the incident

This information may be useful when reporting the incident to the bank or appropriate authorities.

## Important Reminder

Do not delay reporting a suspected fraudulent transaction.

Always use official banking and government channels when reporting financial fraud.

## Source URL

https://www.npci.org.in/fraud-awareness

# UPI Fraud Awareness

## Source
National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)

## Topic
Common UPI Fraud and Scam Patterns

## Common Fraud Patterns

UPI users may encounter different types of online scams and fraudulent activities.

Examples include:

- Fake cashback offers
- Fraudulent QR codes
- Fake customer-support contacts
- Suspicious links
- Requests to install unknown applications
- Fake investment schemes
- Fraudulent messages or social-media communications
- Requests for sensitive banking information

## Fake Cashback

Be cautious of unexpected messages or calls claiming that you have received a cashback or reward.

Do not follow suspicious links or provide confidential banking information simply to receive a supposed cashback.

## Fake Customer Support

## Fake Customer Support

Scammers may pretend to be customer-support representatives.

Do not share confidential information such as:

- UPI PIN
- OTP
- Passwords
- Card details
- Banking credentials

Use official customer-support channels instead.

## Unknown Applications

Be cautious if someone asks you to install an unknown application to solve a payment problem or receive money.

Unknown applications may create security risks.

## Suspicious Links

Avoid opening suspicious links received through unexpected messages, calls, or social-media communications.

Verify the source before interacting with a link.

## Important Reminder

If a transaction or request looks unexpected or suspicious, stop and verify the details before proceeding.

## Source URL

https://www.npci.org.in/fraud-awareness

# UPI Payment and Collect Request Safety

## Source
National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)

## Topic
UPI Payments, Collect Requests, and Transaction Safety

## UPI Payments

A UPI payment transfers money from the user's bank account to another account.

Before authorizing a payment, users should verify the recipient and transaction amount.

## Collect or Payment Requests

UPI applications may allow users to receive payment requests from another person.

A payment request should be reviewed carefully before it is approved.

## Safety Rules

Do not approve an unexpected payment request.

Before approving a request, check:

- Who sent the request
- The amount requested
- Why the payment is being requested
- Whether you actually expected the request

## Unexpected Requests

## Unexpected Requests

If an unknown person sends a payment request, do not approve it simply because they claim that the request is required to receive money.

If the request looks suspicious, reject it or use the appropriate reporting or blocking features provided by the UPI application.

## Important Reminder

Receiving money and making a payment are different actions.

Always check the transaction screen carefully before entering your UPI PIN or approving a transaction.

## Source URL

https://www.npci.org.in/product/bhim

# UPI QR Code Safety

## Source
National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)

## Topic
QR Code Safety and UPI Payments

## QR Codes and UPI

UPI QR codes can be used as part of UPI transactions.

Before completing a transaction, users should carefully check the payment details displayed by their UPI application.

## Important Safety Rule

Scanning a QR code and entering a UPI PIN is used to authorize a payment.

A user should not scan an unknown QR code or enter a UPI PIN simply because another person claims that it is necessary to receive money.

## Before Paying

Before entering the UPI PIN, check:

- The recipient's name
- The amount
- The transaction details
- Whether you actually intended to make the payment

## Unknown QR Codes

Be cautious when someone unexpectedly sends a QR code and asks you to scan it.

Be cautious when someone unexpectedly sends a QR code and asks you to scan it.

Do not enter your UPI PIN unless you have intentionally initiated and verified the payment.

https://www.npci.org.in/fraud-awareness

# UPI Basics and UPI PIN Safety

## Source
National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)

## Topic
UPI Basics, UPI PIN, Transaction Authorization

## UPI Basics

Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is an instant payment system developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), an RBI-regulated entity.

UPI allows users to make digital payments and transfer money using supported bank accounts and UPI applications.

## UPI PIN

The UPI PIN is a 4–6 digit passcode created by the user during UPI registration.

The UPI PIN is used to authorize bank transactions.

## UPI PIN Safety

Never share your UPI PIN with another person.

A user's UPI PIN should remain confidential.

Banks and legitimate customer-support representatives should not ask users to reveal their UPI PIN.

## Important Safety Rule

## Important Safety Rule

A UPI PIN is generally used when the user is authorizing a payment or other bank transaction.

Users should never enter their UPI PIN simply because someone asks them to do so over a phone call, message, or other communication.

## Source URL

https://www.npci.org.in/product/upi

# RBI Digital Payment Safety

## Source
Reserve Bank of India (RBI)

## Topic
Digital Payment Safety and Fraud Prevention

## Protect Sensitive Information

Never share confidential financial information with unknown people.

Sensitive information can include:

- UPI PIN
- OTP
- Passwords
- Card information
- Internet banking credentials
- Other authentication information

## Be Careful With Unknown Communications

Be cautious when receiving unexpected:

- Phone calls
- SMS messages
- Emails
- Links
- Websites
- Social-media messages

Do not provide financial information simply because someone asks for it.

## Suspicious Links and Websites

Avoid opening suspicious links received through unexpected messages or emails.

Fraudsters may use fake links and websites to obtain sensitive information.

Fraudsters may use fake links and websites to obtain sensitive information.

Always verify that you are using the legitimate website or application of your bank or payment service.

## Unknown Applications

Do not install applications from unknown or untrusted sources simply because someone asks you to do so.

Fraudulent applications may attempt to access sensitive information stored on a device.

## Digital Payment Transactions

Exercise care when performing digital financial transactions.

Before authorizing a transaction, verify the transaction details and make sure you understand what you are approving.

## Important Reminder

If someone unexpectedly asks for your PIN, OTP, password, or other confidential banking information, do not share it.

If someone unexpectedly asks for your PIN, OTP, password, or other confidential banking information, do not share it.

Use official bank or payment-service channels when you need assistance.

## Source URL

https://systemhealth.rbi.org.in/cms.rbi.org.in/cms/assets/Documents/BEAWARE07032022.pdf

# RBI QR Code Safety

## Source
Reserve Bank of India (RBI)

## Topic
QR Code and Digital Payment Safety

## QR Code Payments

QR codes can be used to make digital payments.

Before completing a QR-based payment, carefully check the transaction details displayed by the payment application.

## Verify Before Paying

Before entering your UPI PIN, verify:

- The recipient's name
- The amount
- The purpose of the payment
- Whether you intended to make the transaction

## Be Careful With Unknown QR Codes

Do not scan an unexpected or suspicious QR code simply because someone claims that it is necessary to receive money or obtain a refund.

Be especially careful when a QR code is received through an unexpected message, call, email, or social-media communication.

## UPI PIN Safety

## UPI PIN Safety

Never share your UPI PIN with another person.

Do not enter your UPI PIN unless you have verified the transaction and intentionally want to authorize it.

## Important Reminder

Scanning a QR code can lead to a payment authorization flow.

Always check what transaction your payment application is asking you to authorize before entering your UPI PIN.

## Source URL

https://rbikehtahai.rbi.org.in/qr

# Reporting UPI and Digital Payment Fraud

## Source
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and Government of India Cyber Crime Reporting Portal

## Topic
Reporting Financial Cyber Fraud

## Act Quickly

If you become a victim of financial cyber fraud, report the incident as soon as possible.

## Contact Your Bank

Contact your bank through its official customer-care number or official banking channel and report the fraudulent transaction.

Follow the bank's instructions to protect the affected account and banking services.

## Cyber Crime Helpline

For immediate reporting of financial cyber fraud in India, call:

1930

The National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal identifies 1930 as the cyber financial fraud helpline. It is available 24x7.

## Online Reporting

## Online Reporting

Financial cyber fraud can also be reported through the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal:

https://www.cybercrime.gov.in/

## Information to Keep Ready

When reporting a financial cyber fraud, keep relevant information available, such as:

- Transaction ID
- Transaction date and time
- Transaction amount
- Bank or payment service details
- UPI ID or other transaction details
- Screenshots or other supporting evidence
- Relevant messages, phone numbers, or links

Providing accurate information can help authorities process the complaint.

## Important Reminder

Use only official bank and government channels when reporting fraud.

Do not contact unknown numbers or people who claim they can recover your money in exchange for a fee or confidential information.
